page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. The catchword sits at the bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: [?]ro dedit. Imagines venerari plus omnibus voluit: de illarum adoratione ac utilitate librum idola-latra composuit: & ut essent laicorum libri, abla-tis scripturis, constituit. Statuarum execratores, Felicem & alios, in synodo damnauit: in officio Ecclesiae offertoria quaedam versibus geminauit, & missarum ritus à magno Gregorio editos, occi-dentalibus Ecclesiis imperauit. Multarum basili-carum in urbe tecta reparauit: aquae ductus, col-lapsas turres, quassatos muros, & similia ad cle-rum pertinentia, magnis expensis restituit, ac pon-tificatum Romanum ab omni externorum prin-cipum molestatione per Carolum magnum libera-uit: Literas Apostolicas, priui legia, ac diploma-ta, ut diuturniora fierent, plumbo primus insigni-uit, infames (ex Euangelij professione fortasis) ad sacerdotium promoueri uetuit, &, ne clericus ex-tra suum forum, in iudicium traheretur, sanciuit.

Mortuo Carlomanno, Francorum rege & Caroli fratre, Bertha eius vidua cum duobus filijs ad hunc Hadrianum venit, impetratura ut eos confirma-ret, & in paternum regnum inungeret. At pater iste sanctissimus, ne Caroli eorum auunculi ani-mum à se alienaret, pupillos reiecit, causam eo-rum sprevit, in reges ungere recusauit, ac tum de-mum tam matrem quam filios, cum Desiderio Lon

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge; read as "[?]ro", probably "ero". The catchword "gobardo" is at the right below the last line; the body ends with "Lon", and the word completes as "Longobardo". No hyphen is visible after "Lon", so the break is left as printed. "priui legia" is printed as two words and kept that way. The signature at the bottom left is too faint to read and is omitted. No marginal notes or other furniture.
